messages:
frank: deploy-bot flagged ap-east canary p95 surge + 5xxs. Auto-revert in ~3m unless acked.
deploy-bot: ALERT: ap-east rollout p95 390ms (+180ms) and 2.3% 5xxs over 2m. Auto-revert scheduled in 3m. Use /deploybot ack to suppress.
noa: quick check traces? if it's localized node issue we can restart first; if systemic, rollback.
tara: traces show queueing in the new batching path for requests >1k tokens. Looks regional.
frank: propose suppress auto, run a targeted staged rollback for ap-east only to v3.7.4: 20% -> 60% -> 100%, 4m steps. Lee handle acct comms.
lee: will draft short note for Dedicated customers: "We're rolling back ap-east to restore normal performance. No action needed." I'll send once rollback completes.
noa: I'll ack suppression: ```/deploybot ack suppress --thread 1777777001 --by noa --reason "investigate batching path" --until 2026-07-05T07:20:00Z```
deploy-bot: CONFIRMED: suppression acked by noa until 2026-07-05T07:20:00Z (id sup-b72d). Monitoring continues.
frank: execute staged rollback: ```/deploybot rollout set-version --region ap-east --version v3.7.4 --traffic 20% --staged --step-duration 240s --thread 1777777001```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Started staged rollback to v3.7.4 in ap-east. Step 1: 20% -> monitoring.
tara: after 20% p95 down to 200ms, 5xxs 0.4%. kv miss spike <2m then warmed. Proceed to 60%.
frank: continue to 60%: ```/deploybot rollout continue --to 60% --thread 1777777001```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Advanced to 60% at 2026-07-05T07:17:30Z.
lee: account reps notified; they acknowledged.
noa: finish to 100% and pin for 12h: ```/deploybot rollout continue --to 100% --thread 1777777001 && /deploybot pin-version --region ap-east --version v3.7.4 --duration 12h```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Rollback to v3.7.4 completed to 100% in ap-east at 2026-07-05T07:20:35Z. Pin applied for 12h. Telemetry: p95 185ms, 5xx 0.1%.
frank: good. Open postmortem and add a follow-up to tune deploy-bot thresholds for token-size distributions. Also include suppression id sup-b72d in notes.
tara: will file postmortem and include traces. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
